name: Open Trip Planner
description: Open-source, self-hosted trip planner and map place tracker — a Wanderlog / TripIt / Roadtrippers alternative. Save points of interest on an interactive map (category-colored markers, click-to-add with reverse geocoding), track which you've visited or favorited, and build day-by-day itineraries that draw your route on the map. Your agent can plan whole trips end to end through the app's JSON API — geocode an address, drop a place, then assemble days and ordered stops. Uses free OpenStreetMap tiles out of the box; set MAPTILER_KEY for crisper MapTiler tiles.

deploy.title: Plan your next trip on a map
deploy.subtitle: Like Wanderlog or TripIt — save places, build day-by-day itineraries
